6/10
 -- [!! F U N !!   BUT   D I S A P O I N T I N G] --

My hour count is a result of a lack of games to play, nevertheless,  this game has been fun but at every moment past the 15hr mark I've thought to myself "where's the content?"

Essentially if you're the type that enjoys grindy and overly complicated complete freedom sandbox games (kenshi, rimworld, etc), then you'll enjoy it, but likely come to the same opinion as me.

------------------------------------------
SHIP BUILDING AND DESIGN LACKS SERIOUS DEPTH
      Half the game is grinding away at building your space ship, yet there is so little to build decoration and functionality wise. You have two types of chairs, three types of tables, and no real interior decoration other than painfully matching correct floor variants you rarely find (like 5 decor items I can think of that aren't those).
     For functional parts, you just need a ship battery, thruster, pilot seat, and two air pumps (one for O2 and N2). Then you have your fully functional space ship with it's core systems and sadly, it doesn't get much more in depth than that beyond building your first ship's fusion reactor. Like theres no need to build a dedicated life support room on your ship, managing lifesupport systems is as simple as placing an air pump inside a room. It doesn't even matter where you place your thrusters, sensors, or anything. As long as if it's on the ship it flies. It just really feels lackluster, like there's no solar panels, no ship shield room to set-up, no crafting room, etc. The variety for what is there is also very limited. You'd expect water to be an important resource in space, but it's not here. You'll just be storing gallons in your fridge.
-------------------------------------------
LACKING LOOT VARIETY
You'll always be finding the same exact stuff in chests and crates aboard every single ship. Its not exciting.
------------------------------------------
WORTHLESS TRAITS
Theres a wide plethora of traits in character creation, half of which no one has any clue as to what they do. Is cooking a hobby? Well thats never coming up again, and your not going to be cooking anything because its not a feature. Theres just so much that does truely nothing
------------------------------------------
LACKING QOL
There's just so so so much QOL that is lacking, especially when it comes to ship design. Character pathfinding is awful and dumb. Theres a ship building mode in the game, but you cannot import your designs or ANYTHING made in that mode to the real game. There is no planning mode. Darkness always makes building difficult, you can never get a full view of your ship you are working on. To remedy this you can use a 'visor' such as a 'price visor' which removes the darkness and color codes items by their relative value. But in that mode you cannot see any orders you have issued, any walls you set to be constructed, flooring you just ordered your character to put down, etc.
------------------------------------------
VERY ANNOYING CHARACTER NEED BAR MANAGEMENT
Your character has mental needs, such as socialization, talking to family, etc. To solve these it is a tedious task of right clicking your character, and pressing the correct hotkey that lowers the need bar over 20 times or be penalized stat wise. Im not joking, it's incredibly stupid. You will literally spend 3 minutes IRL spam clicking "browse social media, long for a better love life, remember family, etc" to make your need bars go down to keep your character happy. These systems ARE NOT ENGAGING IN ANY WAY and are my biggest gripe with the game.
------------------------------------------
!! BUGGY & UNOPTIMIZED!!
Admittedly, I haven't experience a save breaking bug a save and reload can't fix, but it's annoying coming across bugs that require you to reload the game in order to continue playing. Also, runs a bit hot for what it is and saving and loading takes ages.
------------------------------------------

-- THE REASON THIS IS A POSITIVE REVIEW STILL --
At the end of it all, I still enjoy this game but am disappointed constantly. What is keeping me playing is the exploration and that sense of progression. There really is a ton to explore, space is huge in this game. But the progression is what is really keeping me coming back, you start with rags and work your way to riches and that is just incredibly fun and well done in this game.

6/10
 -- [!! 有 趣 !!   但   令 人 失 望] --

我的游戏时长是因为没什么别的游戏可玩，尽管如此，这游戏一直挺有趣，但过了15小时之后，我每时每刻都在想“内容在哪？”

基本上，如果你是那种喜欢肝、过于复杂、完全自由的沙盒游戏（kenshi、rimworld等）的人，那你会喜欢它，但很可能最终得出和我一样的看法。

------------------------------------------
飞船建造和设计严重缺乏深度
      游戏的一半时间都花在建造你的太空飞船上，但在装饰和功能方面可建造的东西却少得可怜。你只有两种椅子、三种桌子，除了那些你很少能找到的、需要痛苦地匹配正确的地板变体之外，没有任何真正的室内装饰（我能想到的除了那些之外大概只有5种装饰物品）。
     至于功能部件，你只需要一个飞船电池、推进器、驾驶座和两个气泵（一个用于O2，一个用于N2）。然后你就有了拥有核心系统的完全可用的太空飞船，可悲的是，除了建造你第一艘飞船的聚变反应堆之外，它并不会变得更有深度。就像你不需要在飞船上建造专门的生命维持室，管理生命维持系统就像在房间里放一个气泵一样简单。你把推进器、传感器或其他任何东西放在哪里都无所谓。只要它在飞船上，它就能飞。这真的让人感觉很乏味，就像没有太阳能板、没有需要设置的飞船护盾室、没有制作室等等。现有的东西种类也非常有限。你会以为水在太空中是一种重要资源，但这里不是。你只会把几加仑水储存在冰箱里。
-------------------------------------------
战利品缺乏多样性
你在每一艘飞船上的箱子和板条箱里总是会找到完全相同的东西。这并不令人兴奋。
------------------------------------------
毫无价值的特质
角色创建中有大量特质，其中一半没人知道它们到底有什么用。烹饪是一种爱好吗？嗯，这再也不会出现了，而且你也不会烹饪任何东西，因为它不是一个功能。有太多东西真的什么都不做
------------------------------------------
缺乏生活质量改进
缺乏的生活质量改进实在是太多太多了，尤其是在飞船设计方面。角色寻路糟糕又愚蠢。游戏里有一个飞船建造模式，但你不能把你的设计或在该模式中制作的任何东西导入到真正的游戏中。没有规划模式。黑暗总是让建造变得困难，你永远无法完整地看到你正在建造的飞船。为了解决这个问题，你可以使用一个“面罩”，比如“价格面罩”，它会消除黑暗并根据物品的相对价值给它们上色。但在那个模式下，你看不到你发出的任何命令、你设置为要建造的任何墙壁、你刚刚命令角色铺设的地板等等。
------------------------------------------
非常烦人的角色需求条管理
你的角色有心理需求，比如社交、与家人交谈等等。要解决这些需求，就得繁琐地右键点击你的角色，然后按正确的热键超过20次来降低需求条，否则就会受到属性惩罚。我不是开玩笑，这蠢得难以置信。你真的会花3分钟在现实中狂点“浏览社交媒体、渴望更好的爱情生活、想念家人等等”，让你的需求条降下来，以保持你的角色开心。这些系统在任何方面都毫无吸引力，是我对这游戏最大的不满。
------------------------------------------
!! 有BUG且未优化!!
诚然，我还没有遇到过保存并重新加载无法修复的坏档BUG，但遇到需要你重新加载游戏才能继续玩的BUG还是很烦人。而且，就它这个体量来说，运行起来有点烫，保存和加载也要花很长时间。
------------------------------------------

-- 这仍然是一条好评的原因 --
归根结底，我仍然喜欢这个游戏，但也不断感到失望。让我继续玩下去的是探索和那种进步感。确实有大量东西可以探索，这个游戏里的太空非常巨大。但真正让我不断回来的是进度推进，你从衣衫褴褛开始，一路努力走向富有，这在这游戏里真的非常有趣，而且做得很好。
让你的角色保持开心。这些系统在任何方面都毫无吸引力，是我对这款游戏最大的不满。
------------------------------------------
！！有漏洞且未优化！！
诚然，我还没遇到过保存并重新加载无法修复的坏档漏洞，但遇到需要重新加载游戏才能继续游玩的漏洞还是很烦人。另外，就它这个体量而言，运行起来有点烫，而且保存和加载要花很长时间。
------------------------------------------

—— 这仍然是一条好评的原因 ——
归根结底，我仍然喜欢这款游戏，但也不断感到失望。让我继续玩下去的是探索和那种成长感。这款游戏里真的有太多东西可以探索，太空非常浩瀚。但真正让我不断回来的还是成长进程，你从衣衫褴褛起步，一路打拼到腰缠万贯，而这在这款游戏里就是极其有趣，而且做得非常好。

Fun for a bit but the more you play the more it's clear this isn't close to finished. this was quite clearly kicked out of early access by factors external to game development.  aka the publisher, financial reasons or the dev maybe being sick of it??

i'd call it maybe 50% done.

i spent far too much time at the starting station and now that i've gone out and explored the system it's like an empty mall

there's basically 3 functional locations and a dozen more that are empty apart from a few basic NPC's and standard services. 
CQB combat and social gameplay are virtually identical and feel completely unimplemented. they're basically press button to be friendly / not so friendly. for example flirting consists of making a single weird facial expression over and over and over and over again. and you experience that in a scrolling text field.

Crew management is like the sims with terrible AI. it's just obnoxious. when i restarted a fresh save i just didn't bother getting any more crew than the player character.

What is fun and implemented well:

- Ship navigation (RCS or torch drive) it really feels like you're steering a brick through space or a brick tied to a nuclear reactor that's throwing fusion exhaust out of the bottom.
- Ship to ship combat.  caveat: it's basically isolated to 1 location unless you go full murderhobo

What's okay

- Constructing your ship.  it works but oh dear lord is it tedious to design and modify your brick
- Mining.   it's functional and somewhat tied in with ship combat (it's a contested zone).  but not particularly amazing. it's fine.

what's bad:

- Crew control.  Half the time the autotask stops working for some inexplicable reason and you have to take care of every persons needs the sims style.  literally half of the needs are convoluted and annoying to deal with (the social needs) where 1 is almost impossible to satisfy (altruism) 
- 80% of the solarsystem is bland empty stations with nothing special to do.
- Social / CBQ combat.  it's spamming the same things over and over to achieve the desired result with little in the way of useful feedback.
- The performance is atrocious.  loading takes ages, saving takes ages, the autotask function stutters the game constantly if you make your character build something as simple as a 10x10 floor
- There's 0 quality of life.    that 10x10 floor?   you'd better have manually filled some backpacks with flooring cause otherwise your character will grab them 1 by 1 by 1.  i'm just glad there's a mod that helps with picking up 100 pieces of floor first. cause the alternative is that you basically do that manually!

玩一会儿挺有趣，但你玩得越多就越清楚这离完成还差得远。这很明显是被游戏开发之外的因素踢出了抢先体验。也就是发行商、财务原因，或者开发者可能自己都玩腻了？？

我会说它大概完成了50%。

我在起始空间站花了太多时间，而现在我出去探索了这个星系，它就像一座空荡荡的商场

基本上只有3个有功能的地点，还有十几个除了几个基础NPC和标准服务之外空空如也的地方。
室内近战和社交玩法几乎一模一样，感觉完全没有实装。它们基本上就是按按钮来表示友好/不那么友好。比如调情就是一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍地做一个奇怪的面部表情。而你是在一个滚动文本框里体验这些的。

船员管理就像AI糟糕透顶的《模拟人生》。就是很烦人。当我重开一个新存档时，我干脆懒得招募任何超出玩家角色之外的船员。

好玩且实现得不错的部分：

- 飞船导航（RCS或火炬驱动）真的感觉像是在太空中驾驶一块砖头，或者一块绑在核反应堆上、从底部喷出聚变尾焰的砖头。
- 舰对舰战斗。但有个前提：除非你彻底化身杀人狂，否则它基本上只局限于1个地点

还行的部分

- 建造你的飞船。它能用，但天哪，设计和修改你这块砖头真是太繁琐了
- 采矿。它能用，而且某种程度上和舰船战斗挂钩（那是个争夺区）。但并不是特别惊艳。还行吧。

糟糕的部分：

- 船员控制。有一半时间自动任务会因为某些莫名其妙的原因停止工作，你就得像《模拟人生》那样照顾每个人的需求。字面上一半的需求都复杂又烦人（社交需求），其中1个几乎不可能满足（利他主义）
- 太阳系的80%都是平淡空洞的空间站，没什么特别可做的。
- 社交/室内近战。就是一遍又一遍地重复同样的事情来达到想要的结果，几乎没有什么有用的反馈。
- 性能糟糕透顶。加载要花很久，保存要花很久，如果你让你的角色建造一个简单到只有10x10的地板，自动任务功能就会让游戏不断卡顿
- 生活质量改进为0。那个10x10的地板？你最好已经手动往几个背包里装好了地板材料，否则你的角色会一块一块一块地拿。我真庆幸有个mod能帮忙先捡起100块地板。因为替代方案基本上就是你得手动去做！

TLDR: Calling this a 1.0 release is like pointing at a cow and calling it a steak. 

Ostranauts would be my absolute dream game......  if it was actually finished.
I deeply love the idea here, thats why i played it for so long....  But oh man, i had to fight the game at every turn for my fun. 

Rarely have i ever seen a game that is soo buggy, soo glitchy, soo poorly optimized, so critically falwed in many of its systems and controlls.... and yet so engaging(over 100 hours speak for themselves).

All of this would be(and for someone with my tastes veary much is) fine...... for an early acess game... for an alpha. But calling whats on offer here 1.0 is a crime and deeply dissapointing. Especially because the game clearly is someones passion project and anything but a cashgrab.. 

Dont, under no circumstances buy this, unless you are willing to play a broken alpha that (considering the full release) will likely never get adequately finished or even fixed.




Here a List of issues i encountered, this list is by no means exhaustive....  

Buggy Npcs: (i looted soo many EVA suits from random pedestrians walking out the airlock without a helmet)

Buggy Task system: (every tasks is performed 1 by one, from bottom screen to top screen with no regard to distance or required items, my character must easily get in 30000 steps a day in the small cramped ship)

Buggy Life support: compressing gas from a room into a can and than releasing it again magically cools it to -273°C for some reason which in turn reduces its pressure.. making it increadibly hard for heaters to heat it up again...

Missing automation: there is a "signal box" item in the game that even teases us with settings for logical functions... hovever it cant recieve inputs from any other device, so in effect its just a needlessly complicated powerswitch. 

Missing device functionality in general (you cant even customize the "to hot/To cold" threshholds at the thermostat)

Insufficient controll settings in general: not being able to selectively set power levels for directional and rotational thrust is fine in the beginning when everything is super slow, but man does it suck when you pilot your 50 ton custom freighter through the venusian atmosphere and the shortest of cklicks for a tiny course correction sends you spinning to your death becaus you did not revert to 1x speed on your flight that takes 5 real time minutes even on 16x speed. 

Lack of systems variety... the only system that has a direct upgraded version (besides the diffrently sized batteries and the turbo pumps) is the kang rcs intake wich is surpassed by the pricier/rarer hydra. There is 0 variety in regards to thrusters, reactor parts, nav consoles, beds, sensors, tanks..   no upgrades, no sidegrades....  just more of the same old boring stuff. 

Orbital mechanics ar major BS: How come, that when i fly right up to the venusian orbital station and i perfectly align my orbit to it (with the provided match speed setting) it rapidly acellerates away from me the moment i disable the setting? we share the exact same orbit, it should at best drift very slowly towards or away from me. Does it not like me? does it use its thrusters to boost away from me?  

Also, if you want us to engage with orbital mechanics, at least give us a propper maneuver palnner Kerbal space programm came out 11 years ago ffs.
items.text_zh:
TLDR：把这称为1.0正式版，就像指着一头牛说它是牛排。

Ostranauts本会是我绝对的梦想游戏……如果它真的完成了的话。
我深深喜爱这里的构想，这就是为什么我玩了这么久……但天哪，我为了获得乐趣，不得不时时刻刻跟这游戏搏斗。

我很少见到一款游戏如此充满bug、如此故障频出、优化如此糟糕、许多系统和操控存在如此关键的缺陷……却又如此引人入胜（超过100小时本身就说明问题）。

所有这些本来会（而且对于像我这种口味的人来说确实非常）没问题……对于一款抢先体验游戏……对于一款alpha版来说。但把这里提供的东西称为1.0版是一种犯罪，而且令人深感失望。尤其是因为这款游戏显然是某人的热情项目，绝不是圈钱之作。

不要，在任何情况下都不要买这个，除非你愿意玩一个破碎的alpha版，而且（考虑到正式发行）它很可能永远得不到充分的完成，甚至修复。




以下是我遇到的一堆问题，这份清单绝非详尽无遗……

有bug的NPC：（我从随机行人那里捡了太多EVA服，他们不戴头盔就走出了气闸）

有bug的任务系统：（每个任务都一个接一个地执行，从屏幕底部到屏幕顶部，完全不考虑距离或所需物品，我的角色在这艘狭小拥挤的飞船里每天轻松走30000步）

有bug的生命维持系统：把房间里的气体压缩进罐子，然后再释放出来，不知为何会神奇地冷却到-273°C，这反过来又降低了它的压力……让加热器极难把它重新加热……

缺失的自动化：游戏里有一个“信号盒”物品，甚至用逻辑功能设置来挑逗我们……然而它无法接收任何其他设备的输入，所以实际上它只是一个没必要地复杂的电源开关。

总体上缺失的设备功能（你甚至无法在恒温器上自定义“太热/太冷”的阈值）

总体上不足的控制设置：在一切超级缓慢的开局阶段，无法为方向推进和旋转推进选择性地设置功率级别还算可以，但天哪，当你驾驶50吨的定制货船穿过金星大气层时，为了微小的航向修正而进行的最短点击都会让你旋转着送命，因为你在一次即使16倍速也要花5分钟真实时间的飞行中没有切回1倍速。

缺乏系统多样性……唯一有直接升级版本的系统（除了不同尺寸的电池和涡轮泵）是kang RCS进气口，它被更贵/更稀有的hydra超越。在推进器、反应堆部件、导航控制台、床、传感器、储罐方面有0多样性……没有升级，没有横向替换……只是更多同样无聊的老东西。

轨道力学完全是胡扯：为什么当我飞到金星轨道站正旁边，并（用提供的匹配速度设置）完美地将我的轨道与它对齐时，我一禁用该设置，它就迅速加速远离我？我们共享完全相同的轨道，它最多应该非常缓慢地朝我漂来或漂离。它不喜欢我吗？它用推进器加速远离我吗？

另外，如果你想让我们接触轨道力学，至少给我们一个像样的机动规划器，Kerbal太空计划11年前就出了，靠。

Great foundation, but 1.0 still feels unpolished at its core.
I love the core concept of the game, but the 1.0 release still suffers from severe QoL, performance, and UI issues that ruin the experience:

    Stuttering / Performance: Once I operate a mid-sized ship, running the game at 4x speed or higher causes constant stuttering. It gets significantly worse when assigning multiple tasks to the crew.

    Lack of Information: When work stops, the game gives zero feedback on why (missing parts, dead battery, or personal needs/morale issue). Having to manually check every single variable is extremely tedious.

    Clunky Autotasks & AI:
        During auto-repairs, crew members carry loose parts one by one instead of using their backpacks. Is this intentional?
        I can't assign crew to specialized roles (e.g., dedicated EVA worker vs. interior repairperson).
        Zones are also restrictive and frustrating because they cannot overlap.

    Bugs: Critical features randomly break. For example, my airlock doors suddenly stopped responding to electrical signals for no reason. It works when I restart with previous savefile. I have to role-back several times. And why I see the bug information when I reload savefile?

    Frustrating UI & Fixed Keybindings: Awkward quick-button assignments (like fixed hotkeys causing you to accidentally bash floors) combined with frame stuttering lead to constant, maddening misclicks.

Verdict:
The game itself is good and I really want to enjoy it, but these friction points make playing it exhausting right now. I’ll come back after a few more patches.

-----------------

After another full 3 more days:
I accept the concepts. AI is dull, so I do smart. Now I'm carrying crate-of-parts for repairing. Also prepare Autotask step-by-step. Now my hand can expect quick action and press it without misclicks. Most of information are etched. Still improvement is needed, but now I change my mind. Most of them are by design. At least, I accept. Anyway, scavenging is fun.

基础很棒，但1.0在核心上仍然感觉未经打磨。
我喜欢这游戏的核心概念，但1.0版本仍然饱受严重的QoL、性能和UI问题困扰，毁了游戏体验：

    卡顿/性能：一旦我操作一艘中型飞船，以4倍速或更高速度运行游戏就会导致持续卡顿。当给船员分配多项任务时，情况会明显恶化。

    信息缺失：当工作停止时，游戏完全不反馈原因（缺少零件、电池没电，还是个人需求/士气问题）。必须手动检查每一个变量极其繁琐。

    笨拙的自动任务与AI：
        在自动维修期间，船员们会一件一件地搬运散装零件，而不是使用他们的背包。这是故意的吗？
        我无法将船员分配到专门的角色（例如，专职EVA工人与内部维修人员）。
        区域也很受限且令人沮丧，因为它们不能重叠。

    Bug：关键功能会随机失效。例如，我的气闸门突然毫无理由地不再响应电信号。用之前的存档重启后它又能用了。我不得不回滚好几次。而且为什么我在重新加载存档时会看到bug信息？

    令人沮丧的UI与固定按键绑定：别扭的快捷按钮分配（比如固定热键导致你意外砸地板）加上帧卡顿，导致不断出现令人抓狂的误点。

结论：
游戏本身很好，我真的很想享受它，但这些摩擦点让现在玩起来很累。等再过几个补丁我会回来的。

-----------------

又过了整整3天之后：
我接受了这些概念。AI很迟钝，所以我来变聪明。现在我自己搬运一箱零件去维修。也一步步准备好自动任务。现在我的手可以预判快速操作并按下它而不会误点。大部分信息都已刻在脑子里。仍然需要改进，但现在我改变主意了。它们大多是设计使然。至少，我接受了。不管怎样，拾荒很有趣。

items.text:
Bought the game immediately when it dropped in steam early access since I played the heck out of Neo Scavenger and loved it, though the game felt barebones at the time and decided to wait for 1.0 instead of refunding.

Boy am I happy I did that. Is the game perfect? No game is. But does it scratch my tism itch? Hell yeah. There's a bunch of jank and performance issues but I dont think it takes away from the experience as much as some people in here think. Maybe it's because I dont have hundreds of hours in the game (yet).

Tbh I haven't delved into the NPC hiring yet, dont feel it's necessary for the moment, and that's what people complain the most about. I've had a few bugs that were fixed by reloading a save and that's about it.

I -absolutely- love the ship salvaging/building routine. Looking for the good parts, repairing them, selling or using them in your own ship. As someone else said in the reviews it feels especially personal because you install every part the way you want individually and every piece of your ship feels *yours*. It's kind of an intimate experience, building your "baby" and watching it work.

The social game is simply ok for me, feels like a way to deepen the game mechanics and that's fine. Combat is very Neo Scavenger-esque, this time with actual visual representation of what's happening!

I love spending hours optimising my ship and learning how all the pieces fit together, even when sometimes I brick my build and have to backtrack everything. It feels like a rewarding experience.

An absolute gem of a game, even though I couldn't recommend it to everyone. Feels like a mix between Neo Scavenger and Rimworld in space. For me it's a 9/10 at this moment, even without a whole lot of mods and the next year of content the devs promised. If you have the Rimworld tism (especially if you loved the space expansion), BUY THIS.

游戏在Steam抢先体验上线时我就立刻买下了，因为我玩Neo Scavenger玩得废寝忘食，非常喜欢，尽管当时游戏感觉还很简陋，我决定等1.0正式版而不是退款。

天哪，我真高兴我这么做了。这游戏完美吗？没有游戏是完美的。但它能满足我的自闭症癖好吗？当然啦。有一堆粗糙和性能问题，但我不觉得这像这里某些人认为的那样影响体验。也许是因为我还没有玩上几百个小时（目前）。

说实话我还没深入研究NPC雇佣系统，觉得目前没必要，而这正是人们抱怨最多的部分。我遇到过几个bug，重载存档就修好了，仅此而已。

我——绝对——热爱飞船打捞/建造的日常。寻找好零件，修理它们，卖掉或用在自己的飞船上。正如其他人在评测里说的，这感觉特别私人，因为你按自己的意愿逐个安装每个部件，飞船的每一块都感觉是*你的*。这有点像一种亲密的体验，建造你的“宝贝”并看着它运转。

社交玩法对我来说就是还行，感觉像是深化游戏机制的一种方式，这没问题。战斗非常有Neo Scavenger的风格，这次还有实际发生的视觉呈现！

我喜欢花几个小时优化我的飞船，学习所有部件如何组合在一起，即使有时我把自己的配置搞砸了，不得不把一切推倒重来。这感觉是一种有回报的体验。

一款绝对的瑰宝级游戏，尽管我无法向所有人推荐它。感觉像是Neo Scavenger和Rimworld在太空中的混合体。对我来说目前是9/10，即使还没有大量mod和开发者承诺的明年一整年的内容。如果你有Rimworld自闭症（尤其是如果你喜欢太空扩展包），买这个。

[h1]A game that tries to become something it will never be.[/h1]

 [b]WARNING[/b]: [i]Everything said below is a part of my subjective opinion; I may OverEstimate the game idea in some parts of my review or even imply devs are having some 4D-super-strategy-moves mumbo-jumbo; it's okay. That's the part of my impressions I received from the game after I actually started to play it DEEP.[/i]


I've seen various games... Haven't touched some of them, but definitely seen.
Some of them specialised on LSS maintaining like Stationeers.
Some - on how you build, fly and fight on your ships like Space Engineers or Empyrion.
Some - on the travel and (fast)looting aspect, like Pulsar:LC, Duskers or Scavenger SV-4 
Some - on the paranormal/thrilling stuff like VotV or Isolated Inhale...
I also enjoyed the Sunless Sea as well as it's sequel Sunless skies... 
And there was also an specimen of those so-called "Perfect sims" in the face of Shadow of Doubt...

So, the reason why I named all of those games here is because sometimes it's hard to implement even ONE of those aspects, even if you know what you're doing, yet the Devs of this game, without much of appropriate experience, still decided to try and Combine all of those things in a one...

[i]Blue. Bottle.[/i]


Honestly, I've been writing this review for more than two weeks for sure, but I'm still not sure I'll be able to fully convey my dissapointment with...
Ugh... let's say - EVERYTHING.

And the most tragic about that is the fact it's not a fault of bad code (maybe?), questionable choices (perhaps?), or attitude towards the project itself (not at... all? I guess).
Everything bad comes from the game itself... literally because of how it's imagined by design; let me explain...
Do you know what the Ouroboros is? Yeah, the self-eating snake, which can't actually eat itself yada-yada, well... This game is literally It. 
Except it DOES devour itself very vell... And first, let me tell how you will pass your gameplay time in this game:
First 30 minutes would be good, everything will be fast and easy as a light...
Then comes second 30 munites... And you'll start to notice slight issues - microlags, few seconds "to think", stuttering while accelerated...
Then comes the rubicon - At one with a half hours game will be hard to play... slow, sometimes freezing...
And eventually it grinds down to a halt. You find yourself staring at the game that spends ten minutes in "not responding" state for each minute of "responding"... And eventually you just kill the process, wait ten seconds, restart the game(Probably along with restarting half of your apps, because as Game keeps devouring your Ram way past the 12 out of 16Gb, your PC WILL begin to freak out and try to lighten the load by putting everything "not used" into the "halted" state, Steam Included.) and the cycle begins anew.

"Why it's like that? How can we fix it? Why Devs won't fix it?" - You probably asked those questions, and looking into the resmon won't help your curious mind, not unless you read the logs.
Yep, the "Perfect-Sim" ambitions they sacrificed everything else for came back to bite their ass off.

So... Do you remember how you created a character? Unless you instantly hit "seek ship", picked The Retrofit and got out of CharGen (Towards your death, if that's your second char. Or Glory - if you're Professional.) - Game usually spits out a pack of an NPCs related to your aging-up shenanigas... Snobs, Cops, Thugs, Nitwits... Friends or Foes, an "Full deck" if short.
And guess what? Each spawned NPC somewhat DO pass through the same procedure! No, they're not autistically look into the mirror (that has last time seen the janitor probably the moment it got manufactured) like you... 
Yet they do get "rolled" life... And a Buckshot of sidekicks as well! And they also get their own... and again an again an again, until they hit some kind of a limiter, But (Yes there's a persky "But"! Probably an whole gang of "But"s!) it seems this "limiter" works... let's say sometimes (s)he(?) takes a [strike]day off[/strike] full maternity leave - NPCs occasionally multiply like a rabbits, which devoured a whole crate of "Adult chems"... you know (And if you don't... Why the f*ck are you reading this? This game isn't for kids FFS).

If your save had 300-320 NPCs on start - after a few days it would be a 370. Week later = 400... And a two-three weeks later = >500 (And DO thank god for not OVER9000!)
And guess what? Sometimes they spawn with a Ship! Or, if unlucky - on a derelict (I'm serous... I've seen like 5 of those dead ships with "Crew:1" stat. And no, It wasn't a corpses)! 
And with "Fire in the hold" They even get some Tin Cans with a guns! And even fight each-other! Does it somehow impacts your gameplay? 
Only if you're near Ceres WITH your ship but let's be honest - Unless using a PASS there isn't any good way to get to Ceres Quickly and Safely. 
And so there's a whole cacophony of "Creations" is happening like... Everywhere! Ships get created, destroyed, wrecked. Rooms appear and disappear. NPCs appear, travel, choke on the "acceptable algae" and get dragged into the local Valhalla. Sometimes a Pirate or just someone "not from the hood" spawns in and Whole Royal Cavalry of Seasoned OG's runs toward It to ROYALLY Wreck his mug (Watch out for trigger-happy cops!)! 

Oh! And every NPC also Eats, Sleeps, Sh*ts, each and everything you know, except maybe like.... Doing Work? Because in space everyone only Brags about their 12/12(both AM)/7, but keeps watching Drama reruns [i](Except Techies, though... They got two additional madskillz: "FIX-ZE-ZTUFF" and "IDGAF ABT UR SHIP GIMME UR TRENCHIES!"... I mean really... I had to put a Code on my pantry AND Galley doors to stop those "Elements" from ransacking my food/water reserves)[/i] for days and Getting Pissed off by a chair, why? Because he's an uncomfortable plastic b*tch, disallowing anyone reliably relax their ass more that two times in a row! It's even more funny as Game's wiki has a reference on the Rimworld's table behaviour... Uhhh... how do they say it? People who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones? 

And guess what? Your PC has to emulate [Sseth Tzeenach Voice] "ALL OF THIS SH*T", constantly and Simultneously! No mercy! No exceptions! "Be there or be Square, because you're not around!" - That's the motto of this game's simworks!
Oh and rest assure - 90% of that "content" WILL happen OUTSIDE of your reach(Without debug magic) and you know... I think all those quests that many Steam/Reddit players will suggest you not even touch aren't actually bugged... Or at least they wasn't in the first place. Let me cite the classics: [b]"Truth is... the game was rigged from the start."[/b]
It's just the Simulation itself has screwed you up before you could even realize that. 
How? Killing(Figuratively or literally... or sometimes - Both ways at once) an Quest-related NPC and Erasing it from existence ofc!
[i](P.s. THere is a rumor about the Corpse-room... and I'm prettty sure it's the K-Leg's OKLG-UNC... at least when I did a purge there was like... 70 or 90 Dead NPCs on that loc! So yeah... They did it. They did the meme - "Yes, 'Delete' him, and from the Trash bin too".)[/i]

And this is the Main fun-killer of the whole game! Other systems are simply UNDER-developed to present any issues at all or simply stuck in their primitive implementations, without any further development! It's just the fact that your Game tries to Simulate the WHOLE F**KING solar system of various'level deadbeats! And unlike "Shadows of Doubt" which has a finite number of NPCs the Ostranauts decided to have an different approach... 
(And I even suspect the Devs do actually aspire to reach the same numbers of ~1000 fully simulated active NPCs, with a few hundreds of a "Frozen spares", ready to substitute I'm afraid)


Unfortunately there's a limit of how much you can write, so check comments for the remaining part...
items.text_zh:
[h1]一款试图成为它永远无法成为的东西的游戏。[/h1]

[b]警告[/b]：[i]下面所说的一切都是我主观意见的一部分；我可能在评论的某些部分高估了游戏理念，甚至暗示开发者有什么4D超级战略招式的胡言乱语；这没关系。这是我在真正开始深入游玩后从游戏中得到的印象的一部分。[/i]


我见过各种各样的游戏……有些没碰过，但肯定见过。
有些专注于像Stationeers那样的LSS维护。
有些专注于像Space Engineers或Empyrion那样在你的飞船上建造、飞行和战斗。
有些专注于旅行和（快速）掠夺方面，比如Pulsar:LC、Duskers或Scavenger SV-4。
有些专注于超自然/惊悚的东西，比如VotV或Isolated Inhale……
我也很喜欢Sunless Sea以及它的续作Sunless Skies……
还有一款所谓“完美模拟”的样本，就是Shadow of Doubt……

所以，我在这里列出所有这些游戏的原因是，有时候即使你知道自己在做什么，实现其中哪怕一个方面都很难，然而这款游戏的开发者们，没有多少相关经验，仍然决定尝试把所有这些都结合到一起……

[i]蓝色。瓶子。[/i]


老实说，我写这篇评论肯定已经写了两个多星期了，但我仍然不确定我能否完全表达我对……
呃……这么说吧——一切的失望。

而最悲剧的是，这不是糟糕代码的错（也许？）、可疑选择的错（或许？），或者对项目本身态度的错（完全不是？我猜）。
所有糟糕的东西都来自游戏本身……字面意义上是因为它在设计上的构想；让我解释一下……
你知道衔尾蛇是什么吗？对，那条自噬的蛇，实际上不能吃自己之类的，好吧……这款游戏字面上就是它。
只不过它确实把自己吞噬得很好……首先，让我告诉你在这款游戏里你会怎样度过游戏时间：
前30分钟会不错，一切都会像光一样快速轻松……
然后第二个30分钟来了……你会开始注意到轻微的问题——微卡顿、几秒钟“思考”、加速时卡顿……
然后到了卢比孔河——一个半小时后游戏会变得很难玩……缓慢，有时冻结……
最终它会逐渐停摆。你会发现自己盯着游戏，每“响应”一分钟就要花十分钟处于“未响应”状态……最终你只能杀掉进程，等十秒钟，重启游戏（可能还要重启一半的应用，因为游戏会持续吞噬你的内存，远远超过16Gb中的12Gb，你的电脑肯定会开始发疯，试图通过把所有“未使用”的东西放进“暂停”状态来减轻负担，包括Steam。）然后循环重新开始。

“为什么会这样？我们怎么修复它？开发者为什么不修复它？”——你大概问过这些问题，而查看resmon不会满足你好奇的头脑，除非你读日志。
没错，他们为之牺牲其他一切的“完美模拟”野心反噬了他们自己的屁股。

所以……你还记得你是怎么创建角色的吗？除非你立刻点了“寻找飞船”，选了The Retrofit并离开角色创建（如果你这是第二个角色，那就是走向死亡。如果你是职业玩家，那就是走向荣耀。）——游戏通常会吐出一堆与你成长经历相关的NPC……势利眼、警察、暴徒、傻瓜……朋友或敌人，简而言之就是“一整副牌”。
你猜怎么着？每个生成的NPC某种程度上确实会经历同样的流程！不，他们不会像你一样自闭地盯着镜子（那面镜子上次见到清洁工大概还是它被制造出来的时候）……
但他们确实会“掷骰”人生……还有一大把跟班！而且他们也会有自己的……然后一次又一次又一次，直到碰到某种限制器，但是（是的，有个讨厌的“但是”！大概还有一整帮“但是”！）这个“限制器”似乎……这么说吧，有时候他/她(?)会请[strike]一天假[/strike]整整产假——NPC偶尔会像兔子一样繁殖，那些兔子吞下了一整箱“成人化学品”……你懂的（如果你不懂……那你他妈为什么在读这个？这游戏不是给小孩的，天哪）。

如果你的存档开始时只有300-320个NPC——几天后就会变成370。一周后=400……两三周后=>500（感谢上帝没有超过9000！）
你猜怎么着？有时候他们生成时带着一艘飞船！或者，如果不走运——在一艘废弃船上（我是认真的……我见过大概5艘那种带有“船员：1”属性的死船。不，那不是尸体）！
而且有了“货舱起火”，他们甚至还能得到一些带枪的锡罐！甚至互相打起来！这会以某种方式影响你的游戏吗？
只有当你带着飞船在谷神星附近时才会，但说实话——除非使用通行证，否则没有快速安全到达谷神星的好办法。
所以一整套“造物”的杂音正在发生，就像……到处都是！飞船被创造、被摧毁、被毁坏。房间出现又消失。NPC出现、旅行、被“可接受的藻类”噎住，然后被拖进当地的瓦尔哈拉。有时候一个海盗或者只是某个“不是本地人”的人生成进来，然后一整支经验丰富的老兵皇家骑兵队就会冲过去把他的脸狠狠地揍烂（小心那些动不动就开枪的警察！）！

哦！而且每个NPC也会吃、睡、拉，你知道的一切，除了也许……工作？因为在太空里每个人都只吹嘘他们的12/12（都是上午）/7，却一直看戏剧重播[i]（不过技术人员除外……他们有两个额外的疯狂技能：“修东西”和“我才不管你的飞船呢，把你的内裤给我！”……我是说真的……我不得不在我的食品储藏室和厨房门上装密码锁，才能阻止那些“分子”洗劫我的食物/水储备）[/i]好几天，还会因为一把椅子而生气，为什么？因为它是个不舒服的塑料婊子，不允许任何人可靠地放松屁股超过连续两次！更好笑的是游戏的wiki还引用了Rimworld的桌子行为……呃……他们怎么说来着？住在玻璃房子里的人不该扔石头？

你猜怎么着？你的电脑必须模拟[Sseth Tzeenach声音]“所有这些狗屎”，持续且同时！没有怜悯！没有例外！“要么在场，要么就滚，因为你不在场！”——这就是这款游戏模拟工程的座右铭！
哦，放心——那90%的“内容”都会发生在你触及不到的地方（没有调试魔法的话），而且你知道……我觉得那些Steam/Reddit玩家会建议你甚至不要碰的任务其实并不是有bug……或者至少一开始不是。让我引用经典：[b]“真相是……游戏从一开始就被操纵了。”[/b]
只是模拟本身在你意识到之前就已经把你搞砸了。
怎么搞的？杀掉（比喻或字面意义上……有时两者同时）一个任务相关的NPC，并把它从存在中抹除，当然！
[i]（附注：有个关于尸体房的传闻……我很确定那是K-Leg的OKLG-UNC……至少我清理那里时有大概……那个地点有70或90个死NPC！所以没错……他们做到了。他们玩了这个梗——“是的，'删除'他，还要从垃圾桶里删”。）[/i]

这就是整个游戏的主要乐趣杀手！其他系统开发得太不充分，根本不会造成任何问题，或者只是停留在原始实现上，没有任何进一步发展！事实就是你的游戏试图模拟整个他妈的太阳系里各种级别的废物！而且不像“Shadows of Doubt”有有限数量的NPC，Ostranauts决定采取不同的方法……
（我甚至怀疑开发者确实渴望达到约1000个完全模拟的活跃NPC，再加上几百个“冻结备用”，随时准备替补，我恐怕是这样）


不幸的是，能写的内容有限，所以剩余部分请看评论……
如果简短来说，就是“一整副牌”。
你猜怎么着？每个生成的NPC在某种程度上确实会经历同样的流程！不，他们不会像你那样自闭地盯着镜子看（那面镜子最后一次见到清洁工，大概就是它被制造出来的那一刻）……
但他们确实会获得“随机生成”的人生……还有一大把跟班！而且他们也会有自己的……然后一次又一次又一次，直到他们撞上某种限制器，但是（是的，有个讨厌的“但是”！可能是一整帮“但是”！）这个“限制器”似乎……这么说吧，有时候（他/她？）会[strike]休一天假[/strike]休完整的产假——NPC偶尔会像兔子一样繁殖，还是吞了一整箱“成人化学品”的兔子……你懂的（如果你不懂……那你他妈的为什么在读这个？这游戏不是给小孩玩的，靠）。

如果你的存档开始时只有300-320个NPC——几天后就会变成370。一周后=400……两三周后=>500（感谢上帝没有超过9000！）
你猜怎么着？有时候他们生成时会带着一艘船！或者，如果运气不好——会出现在一艘废弃船上（我是认真的……我见过大约5艘那种带有“船员：1”状态的死船。不，那不是尸体）！
而且有了“货舱起火”，他们甚至还会得到一些带枪的锡罐！甚至还会互相打起来！这对你的游戏体验有影响吗？
只有当你带着你的船在谷神星附近时才有——但说实话，除非使用通行证，否则没有什么快速又安全到达谷神星的好办法。
于是，一整套“造物”的嘈杂交响曲就这样……到处都在发生！飞船被创造、被摧毁、被撞毁。房间出现又消失。NPC出现、旅行、被“可接受的藻类”噎死，然后被拖进当地的英灵殿。有时候一个海盗或者某个“不是本地帮派的人”生成了，然后一整支由老资格OG组成的皇家骑兵队就朝它冲过去，把它那张脸狠狠地揍烂（小心那些一触即发的警察！）！

哦！而且每个NPC还会吃饭、睡觉、拉屎，你知道的一切，除了也许……工作？因为在太空里，每个人只会吹嘘自己的12/12（都是上午）/7，却一直看肥皂剧重播[i]（不过技术人员除外……他们有两个额外的绝活：“修-东-西”和“我他妈才不管你的船，把你的内裤给我！”……我是说真的……我不得不在我的食品储藏室和厨房门上装密码锁，才能阻止那些“分子”洗劫我的食物/水储备）[/i]一连好几天，还会被一把椅子惹毛，为什么？因为它是个不舒服的塑料婊子，不允许任何人可靠地放松屁股超过连续两次！更好笑的是，游戏维基里还引用了《环世界》的桌子行为……呃……他们怎么说来着？住在玻璃房子里的人不该扔石头？

你猜怎么着？你的电脑必须模拟[Sseth Tzeenach 嗓音]“所有这些狗屎”，持续不断地、同时进行！没有怜悯！没有例外！“要么在场，要么就滚蛋，因为你根本不在场！”——这就是这游戏模拟系统的座右铭！

This is a game that is just compelling enough to get you to waste your time.

The game isn't done. Rarely will you even be able to do basic tasks in the starter area without the game breaking catastrophically. The good aspects of the game are compounded by half-baked time wasting excersizes. When it does get going, many things don't work; NPCs don't work, dialogue doesn't work, orders don't really work, timelapse doesn't work, plotting a course doesn't work, etc. Like, tell me a normal-ass Oblivion-style dialogue system wouldn't just be better than what's here?

When you are just scrapping a hull for valuable parts and everything is working as intended, it sure is fun, don't get me wrong. I'm all for confusing systems, but they have to work. NeoScavenger was good. They bit off more than they could chew with this one unfortunetly.

Edit: I havent played that many hours of the game, I just left it on overnight because it takes about thirty minutes to load up and is prone to crashing and losing saves. Anyways, I have found the way that this game crashes and breaks the most is with the pathing. Remove things from your ship that cause the path to break, don't hire crewmembers except if you need them and directly order them around (then fire them), and avoid using haul orders and orders in general, as they cause the pathing to break. If you don't think it's gonna work, don't try it; the game visibly stutters when trying to find a path to an order even under the best circumstances. Don't engage with bugged NPCs, you will have to reset your computer this game crashes so bad. 1.0 "release" my ass. Learn how to use the debug. Lucky I am used to playing broken games lol.

If you are really really really into games like this (like I unfortunetly am...) than go for it I guess. You will be fighting the game the whole time.
items.text_zh:
这是一款刚好足够引人入胜、让你浪费时间的游戏。

这游戏还没做完。你甚至很少能在起始区域完成基本任务而不让游戏灾难性地崩溃。游戏里好的方面被半生不熟、浪费时间的练习所拖累。当它真正运转起来时，很多东西都不管用；NPC不管用，对话不管用，命令不太管用，时间流逝不管用，规划航线不管用，等等。就像，告诉我一个普普通通的《湮灭》风格的对话系统难道不会比这里的东西更好吗？

当你只是在拆解船体获取有价值的零件、一切都按预期运转时，那确实很好玩，别误会我。我完全支持令人困惑的系统，但它们必须能运转。《新拾荒者》就很好。不幸的是，他们在这款游戏上贪多嚼不烂。

编辑：我没玩多少小时，我只是让它通宵开着，因为加载大约需要三十分钟，而且容易崩溃并丢失存档。总之，我发现这款游戏崩溃和出故障最多的方式是在寻路方面。从你的船上移除会导致路径中断的东西，不要雇佣船员，除非你需要他们并直接指挥他们（然后解雇他们），并避免使用搬运命令以及一般命令，因为它们会导致寻路中断。如果你觉得它不会成功，就别试；即使在最好的情况下，游戏在尝试为一条命令寻找路径时也会明显卡顿。不要与有bug的NPC互动，这款游戏崩溃得太厉害，你会不得不重启电脑。1.0“正式版”个屁。学学怎么用调试吧。幸好我习惯了玩坏掉的游戏，哈哈。

如果你真的真的真的非常喜欢这类游戏（就像我不幸地那样……），那我想你就去玩吧。你会全程和游戏作斗争。

It's unfortunately just not that fun for the amount of effort you have to put in, and plagued with bugs and performance issues. It's been a delight jumping in every now and then to see what has changed (I purchased this the day it was available in EA, having had ridiculous amounts of fun with Neo Scavenger - and I don't consider the money "wasted"), and it's not flawed because of a lack of passion or drive. It's just one of those titles where the stated vision never quite truly eventuated in a way that lived up to it for me, which is a shame.

I'm not adverse to complexity! I've spent hundreds, thousands of hours in Paradox titles and games like Terra Invicta. The core game loop is - in theory - something I'd enjoy, but the interface and implementation just kills it for me, and the move to 1.0 means I've got to judge this "as is" and I can't say I'd recommend it. Your milage may vary.

我并不排斥复杂性！我在Paradox的游戏和像Terra Invicta这样的游戏上花了成百上千个小时。核心游戏循环——理论上——是我会喜欢的东西，但界面和实现方式对我来说就是毁了它，而转向1.0意味着我必须“按现状”来评判它，我不能说我会推荐它。你的体验可能不同。

TLDR:
Someday, someone is going to give me the deep, fiddley, system-heavy space game I'm looking for.  It doesn't look like ostranauts is going to be it. 
:(
Early Access Review
This is a compelling sandbox, but in no way is it a finished game.  They're saying its less than a month from 1.0 release and it feels like it just entered beta testing.  If there were 1 or more years left on the dev's roadmap I would say this has excellent potential.  It sits in a niche that no AAA developers are ever going to address and it kills me that there are so many near misses in that niche.  I'm probably going to have to chalk this one up as a near miss as well.

The writing is really superb, there just isn't very much of it.  You get a neat little blurb every time you visit a new place.  The intro quest is very well written and easy to follow.  There are a handful of 'story' quests.  And thats it.  Once you leave the starter area (which is a significant task), there is really very little to do.

The new space combat is fine but not terribly compelling.  I was expecting something that requires multiple crew working in tandem to pull off like FTL.  

The AI is absolutely atrocious.  NPCs are largely useless.  The job queing system lacks custom priority settings and causes all kinds of nonsense to happen.  All tools and spacesuits require batteries that the AI is completely incapable of managing.  The dialogue system is a slog to interact with.  Pathing in stations and on bigger ships causes serious performance issues.

There isn't really any 'endgame' activity other than combat.  You spend a significant chunk of time building a ship capable of interplanetary travel.  You can then do some space trucking and make significantly more money than when you were restricted to the starter planet/asteroid/whatever.  You can spend all that money on... a condo and thats about it.

长话短说：
总有一天，会有人给我做出我一直在找的那种深度、繁琐、系统繁多的太空游戏。看起来Ostranauts不会是这个游戏。
:(
抢先体验评测
这是一个引人入胜的沙盒，但绝不是一款完成的游戏。他们说距离1.0发布不到一个月，可感觉它才刚刚进入beta测试。如果开发者的路线图上还剩1年或更久，我会说这有极好的潜力。它处在一个AAA开发者永远不会涉足的细分领域，而这个细分领域里有这么多差一点就成的作品，真让我难受。我大概也只能把这款也算作差一点就成的作品了。

文本写得真的很棒，只是量不够多。每次你到一个新地方，都会得到一小段很精巧的简介。开场任务写得很好，也很容易跟着做。还有少量“故事”任务。然后就没了。一旦你离开起始区域（这本身就是一项不小的任务），就真的没什么可做的了。

新的太空战斗还行，但并不是特别吸引人。我原本期待的是像FTL那样需要多名船员协同配合才能完成的东西。

AI简直糟糕透顶。NPC基本没什么用。任务排队系统缺少自定义优先级设置，还会导致各种荒唐的事情发生。所有工具和太空服都需要电池，而AI完全不会管理这些电池。对话系统交互起来很折磨。空间站和较大飞船上的寻路会导致严重的性能问题。

除了战斗之外，其实没有什么“终局”活动。你会花相当大一部分时间建造一艘能够进行行星际旅行的飞船。然后你可以跑跑太空货运，赚到比你还被困在起始星球/小行星/随便什么地方时多得多的钱。你可以把所有这些钱花在……一套公寓上，差不多就这样。

items.text_zh: 这款游戏在很多方面都实现了我当年期待从《气压创伤》中看到的东西。首先我指的是真实感、真正鲜活的开放世界、高难度和非线性的游戏任务。只不过一个巨大的理念差异在于，我们主要的敌人不是怪物，而是资本主义制度的恐怖，这本身挺酷的，虽然那些怪物本来也会很合适……而且非常遗憾的是，这里没有多人模式，当然，要在这样的游戏里实现多人模式是非常不简单的任务，而且游戏本身目前在技术层面也常常让人失望。但除此之外一切都非常棒，我真心希望这个项目不会垮掉。

I love this game to death, I love its concept, I love the mechanics, I love how each update added a lot of brand new content to the game. I love the ship building, I love the writing, I love the lore, I love the music....

I can't recommed this game. The main reason is that it doesn't respect your time. This is a multi layered issue and I'll explain.

In its state that it has been for years (and will resume to be), the game just runs like complete and utter ♥♥♥♥ and the performance has only gotten far worse. The game is optimized for higher end rigs so if you got a mediocre laptop, you'll struggle to run it. I've lost countless hours combined from crashes and corrupt saves, that's another big flaw. The game will save but in the save folder, the save.info file will be missing so you think you saved the game, quit and you lost all your work. With the 0.15 update, the patch notes toted that they upgraded performance. That's bs, the game runs worse on a fresh save than it did before. More crashes as well, BUT, it does handle long running games better than it did before, I'll give them that. So the baseline performance of the game was hampered, the garbage control (RAM reallocation) improved so you no longer have to restart your game ideally every 2 hours (that's right, that used to be a thing, there were AND STILL ARE serious memory leak issues). Big ships will slow your game down heavily, and this promotes the same limiting mentality on creativity that dwarf fortress also possesses: You limit your projects to something smaller scale so the engine/your pc can run the game and it doesn't run on 2 FPS as your projects become more entropic.

There's a lot of other issues that fall under the curtain and get brushed aside because the game is still in early access, but just because a game is in early access, doesn't give it a forcefield from criticism that disallows it from getting any flak for the current state of implemented features. I say this because I want to address some core features of the game that are flawed on a fundamental level, that are broken but not because the game is in early access. That's the other thing. It's the assumption that a feature, mechanic, system in an early access game is going to get fixed or improved once 1.0 comes out or after. No, these cases are rare to begin with and it varies from feature to feature. The AI's piloting is ♥♥♥♥, has always been ♥♥♥♥ and will resume to be ♥♥♥♥, the AI on station is also just surface level implementation, though the social combat system looks really in-depth, it's incredibly shallow, as most social actions are boilerplate. There have been tweaks and modifications to AI behavior in patch notes and this is the state they are in after so much refinement. Not very encouraging.

The monthly update reports that I viewed ever since 0.13.x days have had many niche logic bugs that come from the inherent complex systems of the game (temperature, durability, inventory system, weight etc.). This makes it far harder and much slower to diagnose and address game breaking bugs. The team's progress is glacial, and a lot of their efforts are spent on trying to maintain the game in a playable state, which they are failing at.

If we removie all that negativity, you have the economy system which is the progression path of the game as you start from a junker ship and a mortgage. The economy is busted and imbalanced, money is completely trivial and it neither rewards the player for hard work, neither does it punish appropriately like when they break the law or pay fines for overdue payments. You can commit a murder and the cops will fine you 15.000 dollars which is a pitance. That mortgage is also getting paid off really fast, don't worry. 

Gameplay wise, the game as a sandbox is pretty empty. Still is in version 0.15 even after they added ship combat and asteroid mining. You have little to no insentive sadly because it's again unbalanced. AI just sits there and takes it while you shoot them, they can't battle with you properly because the piloting AI is so bad. Asteroid mining is subpar to trading wares OR the even more busted gig economy, which was broken even more with the addition of long range travel. You can now pickup a gig in Kleg, Venus or Ceres that's on another planet, have it pay a premium because it's a few astral units away from your location, take a ferry to said location instantly (yes INSTANTLY, they don't even bother simulating travel time with a ferry) and voila, you just made 4-9 million dollars with 0 effort.

So the game is unbalanced, runs like a corpse, the AI is braindead, so what else is there? The main thing? Shipbuilding. That's it. Shipbuilding. It does it really ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ well and it's super fun and relaxing to build your ship. It's a really cathartic process. You get to build your mini home in space and there's seriously indepth customization for it (waiting for them to add planters to the sundries kiosk). It's the main selling point of the game. It's just a shame that other features in the game aren't polished to even a fraction of a fraction that shipbuilding has. Also, sadly, shipbuilding takes a long time to do in general (stripping apart ships, putting them together, repairing them, etc.) and you can't realistically do this whilst also juggling a fulltime job, or have a life. Ostranauts is not for people who have limited time.

TL;DR: Ostranauts has a lot of amazing ideas and concepts but fails at executing them. It runs really bad (lots of crashes and corrupt saves, lots of memory leak within a short amount of time), its AI is really simplistic and has no depth to it, the combat is shamefully undercooked and easy, economy is completely unbalanced which doesn't challenge or reward the player, development is super slow and the updates don't address core fundamental issues... but hey, the shipbuilding is fun.

I hate it but I'll still play it and keep following the development closely. I already know realistically what the devs can and can't do with the shoestring budget they got and the time they have but still praying for a miracle cause I care about Ostranauts. I know the game's performance will forever be ♥♥♥♥, that the AI will forever be stupid and boring, that the economy will be broken and unbalanced, and that the combat will be busted and favor the player... but I still hold out some hope. As it is though, this game isn't for anyone who has a life

我爱这款游戏爱到死，我爱它的概念，我爱它的机制，我爱每次更新都为游戏添加大量全新内容。我爱造船，我爱它的文字，我爱它的背景设定，我爱它的音乐……

我不能推荐这款游戏。主要原因是它不尊重你的时间。这是一个多层次的问题，我会解释。

在它多年来一直处于（并将继续处于）的状态下，游戏运行起来就像一坨彻头彻尾的♥♥♥♥，而且性能只会越来越糟。游戏是为高端配置优化的，所以如果你只有一台平庸的笔记本电脑，你会很难运行它。我因为崩溃和存档损坏已经累计损失了无数小时，这是另一个大缺陷。游戏会保存，但在存档文件夹里，save.info文件会缺失，所以你以为自己保存了游戏，退出后就丢失了所有工作成果。随着0.15更新，补丁说明吹嘘他们升级了性能。那是胡说八道，游戏在新存档上运行得比以前更糟。崩溃也更多了，但是，它处理长时间运行的游戏确实比以前好了，这点我承认。所以游戏的基础性能被削弱了，垃圾控制（RAM重新分配）改善了，所以你不再需要理想情况下每2小时重启一次游戏（没错，这曾经是常态，曾经存在而且现在仍然存在严重的内存泄漏问题）。大型飞船会严重拖慢你的游戏，这助长了与《矮人要塞》相同的限制创造力的心态：你把项目限制在较小规模，这样引擎/你的电脑才能运行游戏，不至于随着你的项目变得更加混乱而让游戏以2 FPS运行。

还有很多其他问题被掩盖在帷幕之下，被搁置一旁，因为游戏仍处于抢先体验阶段，但仅仅因为一款游戏处于抢先体验阶段，并不意味着它有一层免受批评的力场，不允许它因当前已实现功能的状态而受到任何抨击。我这么说是因为我想指出游戏中一些在根本层面上就有缺陷的核心功能，它们是坏的，但并不是因为游戏处于抢先体验阶段。这是另一回事。那就是一种假设，认为抢先体验游戏中的某个功能、机制、系统会在1.0发布时或之后得到修复或改进。不，这些情况本来就很少见，而且因功能而异。AI的驾驶技术是♥♥♥♥，一直都是♥♥♥♥，并将继续是♥♥♥♥，空间站上的AI也只是表面层次的实现，虽然社交战斗系统看起来非常深入，但它极其肤浅，因为大多数社交行动都是模板化的。补丁说明中对AI行为有过调整和修改，这就是经过如此多打磨后它们所处的状态。不太令人鼓舞。

自0.13.x时代以来我查看的每月更新报告中有许多小众逻辑错误，这些错误来自游戏固有的复杂系统（温度、耐久度、库存系统、重量等）。这使得诊断和解决破坏游戏的错误变得更加困难和缓慢。团队的进展如冰川般缓慢，他们的很多精力都花在试图维持游戏的可玩状态上，而他们在这方面正在失败。

如果我们去掉所有这些负面内容，你还有经济系统，它是游戏的进程路径，因为你从一艘破烂飞船和一笔抵押贷款开始。经济系统是崩坏的且不平衡的，金钱完全微不足道，它既不奖励玩家的辛勤工作，也不在玩家违法或为逾期付款缴纳罚款时进行适当的惩罚。你可以犯下谋杀罪，警察只会罚你15,000美元，这简直是杯水车薪。那笔抵押贷款也会很快还清，别担心。

从玩法上看，这款游戏作为沙盒相当空洞。即使在0.15版本中，即使他们添加了飞船战斗和小行星采矿，情况依然如此。遗憾的是，你几乎没有动力，因为它再次不平衡。AI只是坐在那里挨打，当你射击它们时，它们无法与你正常战斗，因为驾驶AI太差了。小行星采矿不如交易货物，也不如更加崩坏的零工经济，而后者随着长途旅行的加入变得更加崩坏。你现在可以在Kleg、Venus或Ceres接一个在另一个星球上的零工，因为它离你的位置有几个天文单位远而支付溢价，然后立即乘坐渡轮前往该地点（是的，立即，他们甚至懒得模拟渡轮的旅行时间），瞧，你刚刚以0努力赚了400万到900万美元。

所以游戏不平衡，运行得像一具尸体，AI是脑死亡的，那还有什么？主要的东西？造船。就是这样。造船。它做得非常♥♥♥♥♥♥♥好，建造你的飞船超级有趣且放松。这是一个非常宣泄的过程。你可以建造你在太空中的迷你家园，而且有非常深入的定制（等待他们在杂货亭添加花盆）。这是游戏的主要卖点。只是遗憾的是，游戏中的其他功能连造船功能的一小部分的一小部分都没有打磨到。而且，遗憾的是，造船总体上需要很长时间（拆解飞船、组装、修理等），你无法在兼顾全职工作或拥有生活的同时现实地做到这一点。Ostranauts不适合时间有限的人。

TL;DR：Ostranauts有很多惊人的想法和概念，但在执行上失败了。它运行得非常糟糕（大量崩溃和存档损坏，短时间内大量内存泄漏），它的AI非常简陋且没有深度，战斗可耻地欠火候且简单，经济完全不平衡，既不挑战也不奖励玩家，开发超级缓慢，更新没有解决核心根本问题……但是嘿，造船很有趣。

我讨厌它，但我仍然会玩它并密切关注开发进展。我已经现实地知道开发者用他们那点微薄预算和有限时间能做什么和不能做什么，但仍然祈祷奇迹，因为我在乎Ostranauts。我知道游戏的性能将永远是♥♥♥♥，AI将永远愚蠢无聊，经济将永远崩坏不平衡，战斗将永远崩坏且偏向玩家……但我仍然抱有一些希望。不过就目前而言，这款游戏不适合任何有生活的人

items.text:
It's a six-year old "Early Access" game that will always end with a game breaking bug. Fun all the while, but heartbreaking every time. 

Seems like its suffering from a lot of tech-debt. You can tell the game is simulating way too much at times, literally every person's needs are simulated. I think if the game didn't need to simulate the station's janitors need to discuss cigarettes, it might run better.

Coding-wise, the game breaking bugs are always character stat related. Often you've unknowingly been cursed by -1000 fatigue or sleep. There's so many stats to maintain that they coded in an Auto-play mode that does it for you!

I think they should simplify the stat system, only have stat systems for your characters, and make satisfying your character's needs something engaging, not something that requires you ask the game to do it for you. It's a space scav game, not a 1:1 of real-life on the ISS.

这是一款已经六年的“抢先体验”游戏，最终总会以一个破坏游戏的bug收场。全程都很有趣，但每次都令人心碎。

看起来它深受大量技术债务之苦。你能看出这游戏有时模拟得太多了，字面意义上每个人的需求都被模拟了。我觉得如果这游戏不需要模拟空间站清洁工讨论香烟的需求，它可能会运行得更好。

从代码层面来说，那些破坏游戏的bug总是与角色属性相关。你常常在不知不觉中被-1000疲劳或睡眠诅咒了。需要维护的属性太多了，以至于他们编写了一个自动游玩模式来替你处理！

我认为他们应该简化属性系统，只为你的角色保留属性系统，并让满足角色需求变成一件引人投入的事，而不是需要你请求游戏替你完成的事。这是一款太空打捞游戏，不是国际空间站生活的1:1还原。

items.text:
It's just way too janky. It feels like the game kinda expects you to have an engineering degree, and the tutorial is dreadfully underdeveloped imo. The screen is clogged with HUD elements and it's a real bother to sort through the fog of useless information to the stuff that actually matters. 

EDIT: After giving it a go since my love for Neo Scavanger made me interested in this game to begin with (the dev is a very talented guy) i fin myself enjoying this work in progress more than i expected after the abysmal tutorial. I get that unfinished games don't have all of that, but it's also kinda frustrating to entrust new players to discord server or wiki instead of having fundemental game mechanics explained to you. And a map for navigating the layers of HUD and well everything. There are manuals, but it doesn't translate easy into practice.

I still cannot in recommend this to any new player, simply because the game has some performance issues, and that the game does a poor job of explaining basic mechanics of the game to the player. 

So what's neat about this game? Well for starters it has immersive first person interactive controls and HUD elements while the game is set in an isometric top-down perspective. I'm not sure if anyone has ever done that before. It's a sim that has many elements of space-faring realism built into it. You can start with a tiny box of a ship and make it huge, or haul stuff, or flip ships or all of the above. It is still very rough at this stage, but it certainly is immersive and makes you feel like a desperate person trying to earn enough to escape a dystopia which reminds one of classic sci-fi franchises.

它就是太粗糙了。感觉这游戏有点指望你有工程学位，而且在我看来教程糟糕得严重不足。屏幕上塞满了HUD元素，要从无用信息的迷雾中筛选出真正重要的东西真是件麻烦事。

编辑：既然我对Neo Scavanger的热爱一开始就让我对这款游戏产生了兴趣（开发者是个非常有才华的人），在试玩之后，我发现自己尽管经历了糟糕透顶的教程，却比预期更享受这个尚在开发中的作品。我明白未完成的游戏不会具备所有那些东西，但把新玩家托付给Discord服务器或wiki，而不是向你解释基本的游戏机制，这也挺令人沮丧的。还有一张用于在层层HUD以及一切之中导航的地图。有手册，但不容易转化为实践。

我仍然无法向任何新玩家推荐这款游戏，仅仅是因为游戏存在一些性能问题，而且游戏在向玩家解释基本机制方面做得很差。

那么这款游戏有什么妙处呢？首先，它拥有沉浸式的第一人称交互控制和HUD元素，而游戏本身却设定在等距俯视视角下。我不确定以前是否有人这样做过。这是一款模拟游戏，内置了许多太空航行的写实元素。你可以从一艘小盒子般的飞船起步，把它变得巨大，或者运输货物，或者翻转飞船，或者以上全都做。在这个阶段它仍然非常粗糙，但它确实很有沉浸感，让你感觉自己是个绝望的人，努力赚够钱逃离一个反乌托邦，这让人想起经典的科幻系列。

The obvious caveat here is this game is early access (at the time I write this) and there seems to be plenty yet to be implemented.

It's a space survival sim set in the nearish future, where humanity has colonised the solar system, but it's still a bit primitive, difficult and risky out there. You start with a small and rickety ship (and need to pay off the large mortgage on it), and you need to build up. 

At core, the gameplay is pretty solid. Mostly, you'll need to engineer your spacecraft, which is easiest to do by scavenging others. You can buy derelicts and fix them up, or strip them and sell the parts, plus a number of smaller quests (delivering stuff, investigating deaths). You'll need to manage your psychology as well as maintain your ship. There are appear to be some sort of wider stories or quests you can do, too, but these are primitive at this point. You'll also need to manage your character's psychology.

Controls are fiddly - learning how to automate commands is a must otherwise you'll spend a lot of time in frustrating micromanaging. This might be the biggest issue and hard for some players to get past: I doubt it will improve a lot come release (but the devs might prove me wrong). The AI could do with some work - your crew sometimes do crazy things like go on a spacewalk without putting their helmet on, NPCs sometimes get stuck in loops. Some optimising also would be beneficial. But like I said, it's early access.

On the whole, this looks promising and I've enjoyed what I've played so far.

It's a buggy mess that'll just raise your bloodpressure. You can go in with the best will in the world. Watch all the tutorials you can find, and the game will still ♥♥♥♥ it all up for you because of some random bug. You'll even get stuck in the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ tutorial mission, because the game won't recognise any actions that you make, if you should for some reason load the game.

Should you make it past that, and think that the game might still be playable;  don't worry, the NPC's have enough pointless actions crammed down their schedule to make your computer stutter all the way to ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ Venus, because god forbid that they shut the ♥♥♥♥ up and stand still for a brief second. 

Then we have the ability to bankrupt ourselves by hiring an NPC! This is a wonderful feature, which much like in real life, comes with some small text at the bottom of the contract, making sure you'll end up in financial ruin. You think you're only paying them for their work ? (which they rarely if ever ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ do btw), nah. They want death insurance as well. If you're not ready to fork over another 80+ thousand to cover that, you'll have to pay interest on top of that as well.

The game is awesome, but it's unoptimized hot garbage, both on performance and user experience issues.

At its core, the game tries to kill you actively and passively in a number of ways, and your job is to figure out how to maintain these many systems in balance as you make a living (most often die) in a sandbox dystopian deep space fantasy.

Some of the survival mechanics were seemingly ripped from NEO scavenger, which makes for a very complete (if discreet) survival game.

Unfortunately, the intentionally hostile game design decisions blend in with the jank and the straight up broken into a frustrating experience that leaves a bitter taste.

I loved my time with it, I don't see myself playing it again. The technical issues (some of which have been present for years) run too deep for the game to see release in a playable state this year.
At full price, it's a big ask.

EDIT: Performance is only getting worse with every update. I have no idea how this game can run at 15FPS on my system. I get thrice that amount playing Tarkov.

NOT playable without extreme frustration. time-waste, UI fatigue, and outright game-breaking problems right now.  As of now, I've thrown up my hands and given up on trying to get this to work.  70-80% of my gameplay time was spent fighting with an extremely user-hostile UI, whether in terms of inventory management or of trying to keep my crewmembers' psychology from constantly, rapidly degrading by extended periods of micromanaged abstract social interaction.

There are some very, very serious flaws in this game that make it almost-unplayable right now and have to be fixed very badly, even for the standards of early access.  I will check out the game later and hope the developer will address them decisively.  For now, though, my recommendation remains an unqualified, resounding NO for everyone.

(1) Dollies and other containers need to be able to be picked up ALWAYS.  I should never have to spend 30 minutes trying to figure out how to get around the "Can't get to The Tetsudo 'SuperHandy' Equipment truck" when my guy is standing right, next, to, it.  This happens constantly and is a major detractor, and on top of that is so unnecessary.  I don't care how many items are piled in that space.  If you make it possible, make it workable.  Fix it, right away.  It's a serious downer.

(2) I really need my guy to STOP walking away on his own when I'm trying to do something.  Doesn't matter what shift, but even on work shift he's constantly, walking, away.  I don't need to constantly herd ADD cats or micromanage their attention.  And never mind crewmembers.  AI behavior should only engage when it's set to AI.  Otherwise I don't want to be constantly fighting the insistent AI for control of my guys.  It's very frustrating and destroys enjoyment.  Fix this.

(3) Crewmember hyper-sensitivity (and inclination to quit) should be turned off until AI is more reliable.  I don't need to be rescuing my non-EVA-suited member from asphyxiation as they inexplicably leave the station to sit in the middle of my atmospherically-compromised beginning ship and then seeing this hit their Autonomy, after which I tediously have to complain about authorities over and over with them to get their Autonomy up, all while fighting their constantly walking away or doing other things and having to wait for them to randomly write a letter home.  Oh, and two other people coming and interrupting and having to wait for that to finish.  This is not gameplay; this is punishment, and it's excrutiating.

I get that you're trying to introduce an awareness and mechanical relevance of the non-instrumentality and needs of human beings as crew, for the respect of labor and its relationship to its employers, and that is laudable for sure, but it is pretty damned punishing and tedious right now.

As I write this, I watched my crewmember's Autonomy drop from green to Opprressed in a matter of minutes.  Wtf?  He'll quit momentarily no doubt, even though he's basically just come off of a two-day break after a day of work.  Guess I shouid just consider crewmembers untenable at this stage of development.

REMOVE this until it can work reasonably.  OR give an easily-accessible debug reset of crewmembers' psych condition so we don't have to spend 50% of playtime fighting with it.

4) Animation-locking for UI elements (like navigation console) and opening inventory on items MUST go.  It's a cardinal sin in a game with this much tedious micro to have every step be locked down in 2-3-second delays by animations no doubt intended to be immersive, but resulting in incrementing UI fatigue.  It's far worse when you have to wait to get in control of the ship because of some UI gaffe.  Don't make me "cancel" the "action" of not-doing-an-action so I can do the action.  (Yes, there's literally a timed, animation-locking action that characters frequently do that is "wait for..." -- a non-action that has to be manually canceled.) 
 Get rid of this.

Other significant but not-as-urgent problems:

1) Loading/saving (and pretty much everything else) needs to permit alt-tab out so we don't have to sit there staring at a load screen that takes 20 seconds before we even see a gameplay tip.


2) Default command keys are bizarre.  Tab should be switching between crew.  CAPS LOCK is a strange choice.  By virtue of the soul-crushing tendency of crewmembers to do stupid ♥♥♥♥ when they shouldn't, I have to switch between crewmembers a LOT to keep them on track; it should have the more conventional switch key.

3) Pressing TAB to switch between characters causes LOADING SHIP on-screen display and 2-3-second delay even if they're on the same ship, right next to each other.

TL:DR: Just read the top two paragraphs.

Note to dev: The real sin in a lot of this is you canNOT force-implement non-working systems.  If the psychology/morale system doesn't work sufficiently to be reasonably playable, either leave it turned off until you have developed it sufficiently, or allow players to disable it.  This was the straw that broke the camel's back for me.

EDIT 2025-05-24: I see the dev is pushing out updates, and that's an encouraging site.  Just waiting for an excuse to turn this review positive -- I do love a lot of what's trying to be done here and will be watching and waiting.

没有极度的挫败感就玩不下去。浪费时间、UI疲劳，而且眼下还有彻底破坏游戏的问题。就目前而言，我已经举手投降，放弃让它正常运转的尝试了。我70-80%的游戏时间都花在和一个极度不友好的UI作斗争上，无论是在库存管理方面，还是在试图通过长时间微观管理的抽象社交互动来防止我的船员心理不断、迅速地恶化方面。

这款游戏有一些非常、非常严重的缺陷，使其现在几乎无法游玩，而且必须非常迫切地修复，即使以抢先体验的标准来看也是如此。我以后会再看看这款游戏，并希望开发者能果断地解决这些问题。不过就目前而言，我的推荐仍然是对所有人毫无保留、响亮的“不”。

(1) 手推车和其他容器必须始终能够被拾取。我绝不应该花30分钟试图弄清楚如何绕过“无法到达Tetsudo‘SuperHandy’设备卡车”，而我的角色就站在它正、旁、边。这种情况不断发生，是一个主要的减分项，而且除此之外还完全没有必要。我不在乎那个空间里堆了多少物品。如果你让它成为可能，就让它可用。马上修好它。这非常令人扫兴。

(2) 我真的很需要我的角色在我试图做某事时停止自行走开。不管是什么班次，但即使在工作班次，他也一直在走开。我不需要不断驱赶患有注意力缺陷多动障碍的猫，也不需要微观管理它们的注意力。更不用说船员了。AI行为应该只在设置为AI时才启用。否则我不想不断与固执的AI争夺对我角色的控制权。这非常令人沮丧，并破坏乐趣。修好这个。

(3) 在AI更可靠之前，应该关闭船员的过度敏感（以及辞职倾向）。我不需要去拯救我没穿EVA服的船员免于窒息，因为他们莫名其妙地离开空间站，坐在我那大气环境受损的初始飞船中间，然后看到这影响了他们的自主性，之后我又得乏味地一遍又一遍和他们抱怨当局来提高他们的自主性，同时还要对抗他们不断走开或做其他事情，并不得不等他们随机给家里写信。哦，还有另外两个人过来打断，还得等那结束。这不是游戏玩法；这是惩罚，而且令人痛苦不堪。

我明白你是在试图引入对人类作为船员所具有的非工具性和需求的意识与机制相关性，出于对劳动的尊重及其与雇主的关系，这当然值得称赞，但现在这实在太惩罚人、太乏味了。

在我写这段话时，我看着我的船员的自主性在几分钟内从绿色降到“受压迫”。搞什么？他毫无疑问马上就会辞职，尽管他基本上才刚在工作一天后休完两天假。看来在这个开发阶段，我就该把船员视为不可用。

在它能合理运作之前，移除这个。或者提供一个易于访问的调试重置船员心理状态的功能，这样我们就不必把50%的游戏时间花在与它作斗争上。

4) UI元素（如导航控制台）的动画锁定以及打开物品库存的动画锁定必须取消。在一款有这么多乏味微观管理的游戏里，让每一步都被2-3秒的延迟锁住，是弥天大罪。
毫无疑问，这些动画本意是营造沉浸感，但结果却不断累积UI疲劳。当你因为某些UI失误而不得不等待才能控制飞船时，情况就更糟了。别让我为了做一个动作而不得不“取消”那个“不做动作”的“动作”。（是的，字面意义上存在一个定时的、锁定动画的动作，角色经常做，叫做“等待……”——一个必须手动取消的非动作。）
把这种东西去掉。

其他重要但没那么紧急的问题：

1）加载/保存（以及几乎所有其他操作）需要允许alt-tab切出，这样我们就不必坐在那里盯着一个要花20秒才显示游戏提示的加载画面。


2）默认命令键很奇怪。Tab应该用来在船员之间切换。CAPS LOCK是个奇怪的选择。由于船员们有一种令人心力交瘁的倾向，会在不该做蠢事的时候做蠢事，我不得不非常频繁地在船员之间切换以让他们保持正轨；它应该用更常规的切换键。

3）按TAB在角色之间切换会导致屏幕上显示LOADING SHIP并出现2-3秒的延迟，即使他们在同一艘飞船上，就紧挨着彼此。

TL:DR：只读前两段就行。

给开发者的备注：这其中很多问题的真正罪过在于，你绝不能强行实装不能正常运作的系统。如果心理/士气系统运作得不够好，无法合理可玩，要么在充分开发之前把它关掉，要么允许玩家禁用它。这就是压垮我的最后一根稻草。

编辑 2025-05-24：我看到开发者正在推送更新，这是个令人鼓舞的景象。只是在等一个把这条评测改成好评的借口——我确实很喜欢这里尝试做的很多事，会持续关注和等待。

items.text_zh: 这款游戏非常出色，它让世界显得不公正，而且你实际上开局就处于糟糕的境地，而不是通常那种别人告诉你一些事情却根本无关紧要的垃圾设定。玩法做得不错但不算极好，有一些bug，游戏中有很大一部分内容完全没有解释，看看燃料亭就知道了，还有买许可证之类的东西XD 我的第一次飞行没有大问题，大部分都解释得很清楚，那么没有许可证会有什么问题呢？警察会给你罚款，幸运的是我在第一艘残骸里随机找到了一张，你猜怎么着，它仍然有效，不到10分钟后太空警察来了并查看了它，我直到10分钟后才意识到他们看了，因为那只是一小段文字通知我（坏事，本可以用更明显的提示）。总的来说游戏还不错，只是UI位置很糟糕，它不断覆盖我想访问的重要数据，而且bug多得要命，我没有做任何故事任务，因为我还没搞懂怎么开始一个，我接了一个基础的“在某人身上放虫子”的任务，光是这个就让我困惑了整整10分钟，因为我在任何对话中都找不到接受/拒绝它的选项，它就在我不知情的情况下自动接受了。游戏需要优化，它加载起来很吃力，有时我有一台中到中高端的电脑配置，加载一个存档或让我的人在更高速度下找到工作都要花很长时间。我不是程序员，但据我所知，在更高速度下某些情况下，找工作的模块更新不够快，正常的修理地板以闪电般的速度发生，然而修理管道已经慢得多，而修理打捞有时甚至根本找不到，即使有需要的资源/工具，它仍然是一款很棒的游戏，会再次购买。

i dunno how this gets to 1.0 in a year, the salvaging and building system is a slog, you cannot mass deconstruct then plan a build on the parts you've selected to deconstruct. even the ship designer system in game is bare bones and a pain to use. you can't refuel, charge and pay your docking fee's from within your ship either, baffling; but that fits the lack of design care in game as your char will fly out an airlock naked no issue and has no complaints about his EVA suit quality, the game can autopause on being attacked but lets you eat vacuum no issue. then there is the 2077 issue of everyone in the game having your contact info and pestering you. it's like an overly complicated poor mans hardspace shipbreaker but not nearly as fun because you're not problem solving, you're accounting.

what i don't see:
mining
manufacturing
non-ship structures to own/build

the game is overly narrow minded where it counts as a space game and overly complex where it doesn't need to be in its sim city goofery [seriously, the fence sees me as a lover for somereason and keeps lightly touching my arm but i hit flirt and apparently they've a hoon meter like you do for your bowls and it's fully evacuated as well so they turn me down, ...], it's "TL;DR" currently not worth it, not even at the sale price. it says i have 20 hours but i forgot it was running in the taskbar at nine hours in; i looked up why the game is lagging hard every minute, couldn't find a fix, forgot i was playing and i had to force myself to get to nine hours in. the game feels barren as all the 'it's a storyboard' games are that rely on you being the content like a solo d&d session.

我不知道这游戏怎么能在一年内达到1.0，打捞和建造系统太拖沓了，你不能先批量拆解再根据你选中要拆解的部件来规划建造。就连游戏内的飞船设计系统也是简陋至极，用起来很痛苦。你也不能在自己的飞船里加油、充电和支付停靠费，令人费解；但这符合游戏在设计上的粗心大意，因为你的角色会赤身裸体飞出气闸而毫无问题，也对自己EVA宇航服的质量毫无怨言，游戏可以在被攻击时自动暂停，却让你毫无问题地吃真空。然后还有2077那种问题，游戏里每个人都知道你的联系方式并不断骚扰你。它就像一款过于复杂的穷人版Hardspace Shipbreaker，但远没有那么有趣，因为你不是在解决问题，你是在做账。

我没看到的东西：
采矿
制造
可拥有/建造的非飞船建筑

这款游戏在作为太空游戏的关键之处过于狭隘，而在不需要的模拟城市式胡闹之处又过于复杂[说真的，那围栏不知为何把我当成恋人，一直轻轻碰我的手臂，但我点了调情，显然他们有一个像你玩保龄球那样的兴致计量条，而且也是完全空的，所以他们拒绝了我，……]，目前来说“长话短说”就是不值得，即使打折也不值。它显示我玩了20小时，但我在9小时的时候忘了它还在任务栏里运行；我查了为什么游戏每分钟都严重卡顿，找不到解决办法，忘了自己在玩游戏，不得不强迫自己玩到9小时。这款游戏感觉空洞，就像所有那些“它是个故事板”的游戏一样，依赖你自己成为内容，就像单人跑团一样。

items.text:
Slowly being able to recommend this game as more and more fixes (and QoL) get implemented through patch cycles.

Originally I would've given this a [b]heavy[/b] thumbs down because the amount of bugs in the game was extremely impeding to actual play.  There were points where I couldn't go more than [b]20 seconds[/b] without having to reload the save due to a bug.  It was infuriating and caused me to quit playing, especially as it compounded ontop of all the other issues.

Now, there's still a lot of bugs, and the game performance is quite poor (both FPS, stuttering and load times; more on loading later), but a lot of the severe ones have gotten fixed.  The game still has high memory consumption, and presumably memory leaks, which leads to lower performance and more severe stuttering the longer the client runs.  [i]I will not give it a "thumbs up" just yet.[/i].

If you're thinking about trying the game, I would recommend looking at Quill18's playthrough of it, either the first livestream he did, or his Youtube series.  It's a good starter for breaking the ice and learning the basic ropes of the game (especially without immediately failing).

What I want to really focus on here is getting more word out about the [b]save/load system[/b].

[strike] Currently, and presumably for the last 4 years, the game has used an archive system for its save files.  Everything is in JSON files, which are then archived (zipped).  Save files are [b]extremely large[/b] when uncompressed (2 day old save is 200MB).  The compression and decompression process heavily slows down saving/loading.

But, the worst thing about this process is that [b]every single time you load your game, the archive is unzipped into a temp folder, loaded into memory, then deleted[/b].  Even if you do absolutely nothing in the save and just quit to menu and reload it, it does this whole process over again instead of using anything that's still residing in memory and matching the data.

In simpler terms:  When you load your save it's [b]writing 200MB+[/b] to your disk drive (probably an SSD).

If you've been playing this game for any length of time, you have gigabytes upon gigabytes, probably even terabytes after a year, of save data writing.

Another user and I have tried to bring this issue up in the Discord, but it hasn't really had any attention.

The developer must add a way to uncompress the zip archive into memory directly (which we discussed is possible in Unity), or rewrite the entire save system to be something other than massive JSON files which JSON editors struggle to even handle (browsers crash, vstudio doesn't support, vscode struggles and no plugin works properly).  Even just using the uncompressed files themselves would avoid much of this data writing issue.

In the interim, I recommend anyone who's playing this game symlink the game's user folder over to a HDD.  It's slower to save/load, yes, but it avoids eating away at your SSD's limited write cycles.[/strike]

[b]EDIT[/b]: This has finally been changed.  Temporarily editing the review this way to not leave out of date information up.
---


[b]Regardless, despite my thumbs down, if you're the type of person who enjoys games like this, you will find enjoyment here[/b].  It's cheap, a sale knocks off a few bucks, and since the Kitfox deal, it seems there's been more rapid development as they aim for a 1.0 release next year.  While I don't think a "1.0" release is really fitting in just a year (content wise), it certainly seems better going than it was previously.

Also, check out the mods in Discord, some are really great QoL and vastly improve the experience.


[i]nb: you can launch the game outside of Steam, so my recorded hours are not representative of my total playtime, which is well over 100 so far[/i]
items.text_zh:
随着补丁周期中越来越多的修复（以及生活质量改进）得到落实，我正慢慢能够推荐这款游戏。

最初我会给它一个[b]强烈[/b]的差评，因为游戏中的bug数量极其妨碍实际游玩。有些时候，我[b]20秒[/b]都撑不过去，就因为一个bug不得不重新加载存档。这让人怒不可遏，导致我放弃了游玩，尤其是当它叠加在所有其他问题之上时。

现在，仍然有很多bug，游戏性能也相当糟糕（帧率、卡顿和加载时间都是如此；关于加载后面会详细说），但很多严重的问题已经得到修复。游戏仍然有很高的内存消耗，想必还有内存泄漏，这导致客户端运行时间越长，性能越低，卡顿越严重。[i]我还不会给它“好评”。[/i]。

如果你正在考虑尝试这款游戏，我建议看看Quill18的游玩视频，要么是他第一次直播的内容，要么是他的YouTube系列。这是一个很好的入门材料，可以打破僵局并学习游戏的基本要领（尤其是避免一上来就失败）。

我在这里真正想重点谈的是让更多人了解[b]存档/读档系统[/b]。

[strike]目前，而且想必在过去4年里，游戏一直使用归档系统来保存存档文件。所有内容都在JSON文件中，然后被归档（压缩）。未压缩时存档文件[b]极其庞大[/b]（2天前的存档就有200MB）。压缩和解压缩过程严重拖慢了保存/加载速度。

但这个过程最糟糕的地方在于，[b]每次你加载游戏时，归档文件都会被解压到一个临时文件夹，加载到内存中，然后被删除[/b]。即使你在存档中什么都不做，只是退出到菜单再重新加载，它也会把整个过程重来一遍，而不是利用任何仍然驻留在内存中且与数据匹配的内容。

用更简单的话说：当你加载存档时，它正在向你的磁盘驱动器（可能是SSD）[b]写入200MB以上[/b]的数据。

如果你玩这款游戏有一段时间了，你已经写入了数以GB计、甚至一年后可能数以TB计的存档数据。

我和另一位用户曾试图在Discord上提出这个问题，但并没有真正引起任何关注。

开发者必须添加一种方法，将zip归档直接解压到内存中（我们讨论过这在Unity中是可行的），或者重写整个存档系统，使其不再是庞大的JSON文件——JSON编辑器甚至连处理它们都很吃力（浏览器崩溃，vstudio不支持，vscode很吃力，没有插件能正常工作）。即使只是使用未压缩的文件本身，也能避免大部分这种数据写入问题。

在此期间，我建议任何玩这款游戏的人把游戏的用户文件夹符号链接到HDD上。是的，保存/加载会更慢，但这可以避免消耗你SSD有限的写入寿命。[strike]

[b]编辑[/b]：这个问题终于被改变了。暂时以这种方式编辑评测，以免留下过时的信息。
---


[b]无论如何，尽管我给了差评，如果你是那种喜欢这类游戏的人，你会在这里找到乐趣[/b]。它很便宜，打折时还能再省几块钱，而且自从Kitfox交易以来，似乎开发速度加快了，因为他们目标是在明年发布1.0版本。虽然我认为仅仅一年就发布“1.0”（从内容角度来说）并不太合适，但它
肯定看起来比之前进展得更好了。

另外，去看看Discord里的模组，有些真的很棒，能大幅提升生活质量，极大地改善游戏体验。


[i]注：你可以在Steam之外启动游戏，所以我记录的时长并不代表我的总游戏时间，到目前为止我的总时长早已超过100小时[/i]

items.text:
[b] *Остро-навты* [/b]

Когда я взялся играть в ЭТО... мне сразу вспомнился набивший аскомину NMS. Но, обо всём по порядку!
Как всегда, присаживайтесь, заварите чайку или кофейку...
Сартуем!!!

[b] *A long time ago, in a galaxy far-far away...* [/b]

Пару слов о разработке.
Натыкался я на новости о старте проекта ещё году, наверно в 20-м, точнее не скажу. Было интервью с разработчиками NEO Scavenger и кто-то из отцов обмолвился, что изначально движ должен был происходить в космосе, но опыт, механики, молодо-зелено... Штош... Сейчас парни со скрипом, долго, муторно, с болью в душе (видимо), возможно с надрывом пилят очередное своё детище. И посмотреть тут есть на что, я вам доложу. Стопицот механик, необычное управление, интересные взаимодействия, но главное... запомните... [b] ЭТО НЕ БАЛДРА-3 [/b]!!! Вашу-ж мать... Или нет?! ))) 
Будем посмотреть, а пока идут технические работы, поиграем и оценим что-же получается.

[b] *Сколько лет прошло, холод жжёт в груди...* [/b]
[b] *Эй Земля алло! Я Вояджер один!* [/b]

Ганимед.
Вы начинаете как молодой, рядовой сотрудник корпорации по утилизации брошенных/сломанных космосудов. В ваши обязанности будет вхо... стоп!

Дубль два. Поехали.
Начало.
Мало кто вспомнит сейчас старый добрый Jagged Alliance 2, но именно там я впервые познакомился с генерацией персонажа через "текстовое тестирование". Собственно, здесь, вы не выбираете себе набор трэйтов, перков, скиллов, не выбираете "класс" персонажа. Вы родились в далёком космосе, выросли, вам 18. И перед вами открытый мир и мечта о свободе и собственном корабле. Учитесь, тусуйтесь, копите деньги, влипайте в истории вынося оттуда ценный опыт, обрастая связями, обретая друзей или заклятых врагов. Вас может покидать по "местам не столь отдалённым"... Но учтите! Время... Время - единственный и самый ценный ваш ресурс. Здоровье подорвётся, годы уйдут и многое станет в тягость. То, что вы можете намутить в 20, в 40 намутить уже... трудновато будет... физически. Поэтому рассчитывайте как вы планируете потратить отведённое вам время, не растратьте его попусту.

Вы сами генерируете биографию персонажа через текстовые события, резюмируете итог, покупаете судно, естественно в кредит, а как без этого, проклятые корпорации высосут из вас все соки, перетрут и используют, а затем сварят из вас белковую смесь! Ну... это в теории... Что-то я отвлёкся, продолжим.

[b] *Гагарин! Я вас любила! Ой! На-на-на-на!* [/b]

Игровое поле и интерфейсы.

Ох и шатал-дремал я это всё! Вам просто придётся привыкать. Аутентичный интерфейс знакомый игрокам в NEO Scavenger, отдалённо напоминает суперхит для low-grade PC или задротов вроде меня - Cataclysm:DDA или Cataclysm:BN (рекомендую ознакомиться с вопросом). СЛОЖНА! Честно... блин... 
Хотите управлять кораблём? Извольте ознакомиться с приборной панелью "Polaris" и... текстовым мануалом. Хотите понять как сделать ваш корабль не капсулой с вакуумом, а обитаемым островком с атмосферой? Будте любезны, вот мануал по окружайке (Environment)!
Инвентари - головная боль! Они нифига не такие удобные как в NEO, да и вообще не удобные, но тут сложности с реализацией механик сборки и запила корабля, торговли, боёвки. Парни поднимают такой пласт разработки шо пипец. И это заслуживает похвалы и уважения. Учиться, рисковать, строить новое, отличное от основного рынка - дорогого стоит.

[b] *И мы бросаемся в костёр,* [/b] 
[b] *Нам и в аду не будет жарко!* [/b]
[b] *На этом свете нас спасёт* [/b]
[b] *лишь МОЛОТ, СВАРКА и БОЛГАРКА!* [/b]

Основной геймплей.

Всё построено на бомжевании. У вас есть магазины на станциях, но эти магазы скупают лом и не продадут вам, скажем... Двигатели. Или батареи. Или нужные именно для вашего судна полы... Да много чего они вам не продадут, зато с удовольствием купят всё, или почти всё, что вы им приволокёте. Потому что вам нужно именно отволочь к прилавку скажем... Реактор, который вы скрутили вооон с той светящейся точки на карте. Единственное, что станция для вас гарантированно предоставит - услуги докинга, дозаправки, подзарядки... не бесплатно, конечно же. Да господи! Вы вообще цены на топливо видели?! Это просто грабёж! Ползарплаты на заправке оставляю, прихожу кнопки подавить, и на тебе, страссье, давненько не видал таких циферок! А так же не стоит забывать про кредит на вашу "ласточку" иначе а-та-та! Мрак.

Для того чтобы работать в открытом космосе нужен надёжный скафандр, стартовый гермокостюм для вакуума подойдёт, но не для вылазок в открытый космос, учтите это. Также вам нужны инструменты для работы, собственно - резаки, отвёртки, паяльники и прочие слесарские штуки. И поверьте - выбрать есть из чего.

Второй вариант заработка - перекупы. Всмысле... Вы тот самый перекуп, который: "Да не бита, не крашена, в ДТП не участвовала, документы чистые!". Есть брокер на станции, есть вариант выкупить брошенку, подлатать, загнать обратно по увеличенной стоимости, всё в ваших руках.

[b] *А звёзды тем не менее, а звёзды тем не менее, всё ближе, но всё так же холодны...* [/b]

Я намеренно не пишу тут об очевидных проблемах раннего доступа - оптимизация хромает, некоторые механики и код работают хрен-пойми как, глючат NPC, хаулеры в космосе носятся как твой сосед на "четырке". Важнее всего атмосфера и сам геймплей. Если вспомнить парней из Hello Games, они просто релизнули игру, внимание, РЕЛИЗНУЛИ. Так что, скорее всего парни понимают и используют опыт коллег - основная задача: выработать основу, которую потом можно улучшать до бесконечности.

Чем был NMS на релизе?
Каким был визуал и функционал Factorio на момент взлёта популярности?
Количество функциональных блоков на момент Early access в Space Engineers?
Вы точно уверенны в Star Citizen?
Сколько разрабатывалась Barotrauma?

Я вам приведу ещё с десяток проектов на которые, в теории, тоже можно было бы махнуть рукой, но в которые играют и по сей день...

[b] *Мне от вас, пессимистов, тошно! Все беды из-за нытья "вонючего" вашего...* [/b]

В данный момент ведётся активная разработка.
Как это можно видеть по билдам? Например сейчас уже есть огнетушители, но! Боевые суда и симуляция огня, судя по дорожной карте, будут ещё о-го-го как не скоро. На носу апдейт всей системы игры, новая механика, интерпланетарные перелёты, новые двигатели, новые вызовы. Я считаю что команда нуждается в поддержке именно сейчас, когда формируется кор-гейм. Кроме того, на данном этапе разработки игра вполне подойдёт, чтобы скоротать пару вечеров за лутанием и распилом дереликтов - процесс залипательный.

С учётом стоимости - рекомендую к покупке.

[b] *太空流浪汉* [/b]

当我开始玩这个的时候……我立刻想起了那个让人腻歪的《无人深空》。不过，咱们还是按顺序来吧！
一如既往，请坐下，泡杯茶或咖啡……
开整！！！

[b] *很久很久以前，在一个遥远的星系……* [/b]

关于开发说几句。
我大概在20年的时候，可能吧，更准确我说不准，就撞见过关于项目启动的新闻。当时有对《NEO Scavenger》开发者的采访，某位元老提到，最初引擎本该设定在太空，但经验、机制、年轻稚嫩……好吧……现在这帮人正吱吱嘎嘎、漫长、烦闷、带着灵魂深处的痛苦（大概吧），也许还带着撕裂感，打磨着他们的又一个心血结晶。而且我得告诉你们，这里确实有看头。成百上千的机制，不寻常的操作，有趣的互动，但最重要的是……记住……[b] 这不是《博德之门3》 [/b]！！！去你妈的……或者不是？！）））
咱们走着瞧，趁现在还在技术施工，先玩玩看，评估一下到底做出来个啥。

[b] *多少年过去了，寒冷灼烧着胸膛……* [/b]
[b] *嘿地球，你好！我是旅行者一号！* [/b]

木卫三。
你一开始是某家回收废弃/损坏太空船公司的年轻普通员工。你的职责将包括……停！

第二条。走起。
开头。
现在很少有人还记得老好人《铁血联盟2》，但正是在那里，我第一次接触到通过“文本测试”来生成角色。其实在这里，你不选择一套特质、专长、技能，也不选择角色的“职业”。你出生在遥远的太空，长大了，你18岁。你面前是开放世界，以及对自由和拥有自己飞船的梦想。学习、混日子、攒钱、卷入各种故事并从中带走宝贵经验，积累人脉，结交朋友或死敌。你可能会被送进“不那么遥远的地方”……但注意！时间……时间是你唯一且最宝贵的资源。健康会垮掉，岁月会流逝，很多事情会变得力不从心。你20岁能搞到的东西，40岁再搞就已经……有点难了……身体上。所以好好盘算你打算怎么花掉分配给自己的时间，别白白浪费。

你自己通过文本事件生成角色传记，总结结果，买船，当然是贷款，不然怎么行，该死的公司会把你榨干，揉碎，利用完，然后把你熬成蛋白混合物！嗯……理论上如此……我有点跑题了，继续。

[b] *加加林！我爱过您！哎哟！呐-呐-呐-呐！* [/b]

游戏场景和界面。

哎呀，我可被这一切折腾得够呛！你只能去习惯。熟悉《NEO Scavenger》玩家的那种原汁原味界面，隐约让人想起低配PC或像我这种硬核宅的超级神作——《Cataclysm:DDA》或《Cataclysm:BN》（建议了解一下）。难！说实话……妈的……
想操控飞船？那就请去熟悉“Polaris”仪表盘和……文本手册。想搞明白怎么让你的飞船不再是个真空胶囊，而是有大气层的可居住小岛？劳驾，这是环境（Environment）手册！
物品栏——头疼！它们根本不像《NEO》里那么方便，而且总体来说也不方便，但这里有组装和打造飞船、贸易、战斗机制实现上的困难。这帮人扛起的开发量简直吓人。这值得称赞和尊重。学习、冒险、建造不同于主流市场的新东西——这很了不起。

[b] *而我们扑向火堆，* [/b] 
[b] *就算在地狱我们也不会觉得热！* [/b]
[b] *在这个世界上能救我们的* [/b]
[b] *只有大锤、焊接和角磨机！* [/b]

主要玩法。

一切都建立在捡破烂上。空间站上有商店，但这些商店收购废料，却不会卖给你，比如说……引擎。或者电池。或者正好适合你这艘船的地板……很多东西他们都不会卖给你，但会很乐意买下你拖来的一切，或者几乎一切。因为你需要把比如说……你从地图上那个发光点拧下来的反应堆，拖到柜台前。空间站唯一能保证提供给你的，就是对接、加油、充电服务……当然，不是免费的。天哪！你到底看过燃料价格吗？！这简直是抢劫！我一半工资都留在加油站了，回来按几个按钮，好家伙，压力山大，好久没见过这种数字了！另外也别忘记你那辆“小燕子”的贷款，不然就等着挨收拾吧！黑暗。

要在外太空工作，你需要可靠的宇航服，初始的真空密封服可以凑合，但不适合出舱进入外太空，记住这一点。你还需要工作工具，也就是切割器、螺丝刀、烙铁之类的钳工玩意儿。相信我——可选的很多。

第二种赚钱方式——倒卖。我是说……你就是那种倒爷：“没撞过，没喷过漆，没出过事故，手续干净！”空间站上有经纪人，也可以买下废弃船，修一修，再以更高价格卖回去，一切都在你手里。

[b] *然而星星依旧，然而星星依旧，越来越近，却依旧那么寒冷……* [/b]

我故意不在这里写抢先体验版那些显而易见的问题——优化拉胯，有些机制和代码运行得莫名其妙，NPC出故障，太空里的搬运船像你邻居开“四号”一样乱窜。最重要的是氛围和玩法本身。如果回想《Hello Games》那帮人，他们就是直接发行了游戏，注意，是发行了。所以，很可能这帮人理解并借鉴了同行的经验——主要任务是：打下一个基础，之后可以无限改进。

《Barotrauma》开发了多久？

我还能给你举出十几个项目，理论上也可以对它们摆摆手，但人们至今还在玩……

目前正在积极开发中。
怎么从版本里看出来？比如现在已经有灭火器了，但是！战斗船只和火焰模拟，根据路线图，还早得很呢。即将迎来整个游戏系统的更新、新机制、行星间飞行、新引擎、新挑战。我认为团队正需要支持，尤其是在核心玩法成型的现在。此外，在当前开发阶段，这游戏完全适合花几个晚上在搜刮和拆解废弃船中消磨时间——这个过程很上头。
